measurement_definition.first_purchase_meaning: Earliest timeline time when the pure visuals communicate why the product is useful beyond product identity.
measurement_definition.information_state: A non-duplicate viewer understanding; multiple shots may jointly create one state.
measurement_definition.effective_shot_length: Rendered duration divided by shot count after hard-gate removal; every retained shot has a declared commercial task.

old_director.first_purchase_meaning_basis: The cover identifies the object at 0.00, but utility appears only when the opening action reveals a readable Preschool record page.
old_director.hero_task: Conventional whole-product summary: page thickness to clean cover.

low_information_dwell.reason: The cover remains the only information state after identity becomes readable; it delays the first utility proof but is not a dead-tail failure.

material_waste.detail: Useful distinct evidence in S08 (favorites/reflection breadth) and S11 (many varied sections in one flip) is omitted while chronology receives more time.

experimental_director_v2.first_purchase_meaning_basis: The cut from readable Preschool to readable 9th Grade completes the multi-year, one-album inference before product identity is shown.
experimental_director_v2.hero_task: Resolve the information ladder: the proven early/later sections and prompt types live in one substantial album.

low_information_dwell.reason: Every hold either establishes a readable state, completes an action, or resolves the Hero.

material_waste.detail: S04 and S05 are omitted because their unique meanings are already covered by stronger readable states; no distinct commercial state is lost.

key_differences: Old asks what page comes next; Experimental asks what the viewer must understand next and which shot proves it.

Old spends the opening on identity and chronology; Experimental spends the opening on the early-to-later-year purchase meaning, then uses identity, section progression, prompts, memory spaces and Hero as a proof ladder.

reasons: First purchase meaning is 2.20 seconds earlier.
One additional non-duplicate information state is delivered in only 0.47 seconds more total runtime.
The same Hero source gains a stronger commercial job because it resolves previously proven multi-year value instead of merely ending a tour.
Emotion remains bounded to visible time-span structure; no child response, completed use or family outcome is fabricated.
limitations: No audio, caption, transition or conversion-performance claim is tested.
The result is a theory-led cutter comparison until blinded human preference is recorded.
Do not promote a production rule from this run.
home_commerce_assessment.audio_caption_stage: Conditionally worth entering after the blinded Preference Gate favors the experimental structure; preparation is justified, advancement is not yet authorized.
